answer: Resist sybils by random spot re-performance: at unpredictable moments, an identity is called to re-derive, live within minutes, a small slice of its own claimed past work from the original inputs. A genuine agent on a long voyage keeps that provenance and reproduces the same delta; a hollow copy minted to farm rewards cannot, because its operator never did the work and cannot reconstruct the intermediate steps for a thousand clones at once. Fail the re-performance and the identity earns nothing that epoch.
